Form No: HCJD/C-121 ORDER SHEET. IN THE ISLAMABAD HIGH COURT, ISLAMABAD. JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT. Writ Petition No.4134 of 2021 Ghulam Bilal Ahmed. VS Mst. Nagina Saghir and 02 others. S. No. of order/ proceedings Date of order/ Proceedings Order with signature of Judge and that of parties or counsel where necessary. 10. 02.07.2024 Nemo. Today, the case was called on its turn as well as before rising of the Court, but on both occasions, no one tendered appearance on behalf of the petitioner. The name of learned counsel for the petitioner is reflected in the cause list. There is no application for an adjournment, therefore, the instant petition is dismissed for non- prosecution. (TARIQ MEHMOOD JAHANGIRI) JUDGE M. Zaheer Janjua
verdict: In favor of respondents - due to petitioner's non-prosecution.
